tools.name: get_fuel_prices
tools.description: Read the latest verified and confirmed upcoming official maximum fuel prices, effective dates, review/freshness status, and sources. Optionally choose a region and fuel.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Read a bounded page of verified historical official fuel prices. Follow nextCursor until isDone; gaps mean missing evidence, not unchanged prices.

tools.name: find_fuel_articles
tools.description: Find Portuguese and English guides to Azores and Madeira fuel prices, official sources, regional comparisons, refill calculations, refuelling as a visitor and using FuelAzores. Use an article id and language to retrieve its complete Markdown. Dated examples are not live prices.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_fuel_prices" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.
